exposure: type of needle used for dural puncture
diameter of the needle used for dural puncture
outcome: treatment response with epidural blood patch (EBP)
cohort: 77 patients who had PDPH and were treated with EBP
finding: Epidural blood patch (EBP) is an effective and relatively safe method for treating post dural puncture headache (PDPH), especially in obstetric patients.
mod_finding: This study found that epidural blood patch (EBP) is an effective treatment for post dural puncture headache (PDPH), especially in obstetric patients.
